bio: Louise Easen was born in England on 4 August 1878, the daughter of Thomas Easen (1848-1932) and Mary Barnes (1850-1921), and came to America as an infant in 1879 or 1880. On 20 June 1900 she married Thomas F. Heffernan; the marriage record spells her name Louisa Essen. She was living in Wilkes-Barre in 1950 and died in Philadelphia on 16 June 1960. She was buried at Fern Knoll in Dallas, Luzerne Co., Pa.
